items.Description: Made of hot liquid poured over scorched and pungent beans, this strong-smelling brew did not get its name from its appearance. It helps clear and fortify the mind against spells that affect the mind.

items.Name: Potion of Greater Strength
items.Description: These blood-red infusions, made from the horns and heart of young bulls, grant the drinker great physical strength.
PropertiesDecoded: Greater Bull's Strength(11) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Raid Plans
items.Description:
A rough skin map of the area shows the routes of past and planned Giant raids into the human lands.

On the back of the map are a set of instructions for the raids, written in Hill Giant, and signed "Eclavdra."

items.Name: Report to Jarl
items.Description: This gold-inlayed skull has a report inside. The report is from Nosnra, the Hill Giant Chief, to Grugnir, the Frost Giant Jarl. It details the recent successful raids against the human lands.

items.Name: Ring of Elemental Command
items.Description: Rings of this type are forged on the Inner Planes and bear a strong connection to the elemental forces of that place.
PropertiesDecoded: Summon Creature IX (17) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Ring of Delusion
items.Description: This seems to be a Ring of Clear Thought +3.

items.Name: Ring of Shooting Stars
items.Description: This mystic band of silver seems to glow with the captured radiance of starlight. It can be used to call down celestial bodies from the sky.

items.Name: Robe of the Archmagi
items.Description: While garments like this have been found in almost every culture with a strong contingent of spellcasters, this example originated within Boccob's School of Wizardry.

items.Name: Rod of Cancellation
items.Description: These devices are pleasant enough to look at, crafted of solid oak and highlighted with a modest gem or two. More importantly, the rods are potent magic items.

items.Name: Scimitar +3, Frost Brand
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Shield of Missile Attraction
items.Description: This looks exactly like a Shield vs. Missiles.

items.Name: Silver-Lined Box of Ivory
items.Description:
The mages of the Empire of Netheril once played the card game of Hazard for idle amusement, building decks of slightly magical cards to use in friendly competition against each other.

In the millennia since the fall of Netheril, however, the magic in the surviving decks has gra…

items.Name: Snurre's Greatsword
items.Description: The flaming sword of the Fire Giant King was forged deep in the heart of an active volcano.

items.Name: Solid Silver Statue of a Bear
items.Description: This pure gold chalice is finely worked and bears the symbol of a sun rising upon a blooming rose. On command, it sheds a bright light equal to a light spell. The chalice can be commanded to create a healing circle, which uses one charge. When all three of its charges have been …

items.Name: Speed Ring
items.Description: Speed Rings are made by highly skilled archmagi - usually involving great power to create this fantastic item.

items.Name: Giant Slaying Sword
items.Description: A paranoid Hill Giant Chief and then later a Cloud Giant wielded this sword to help keep his inferiors in line.
PropertiesDecoded: Giant Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d8 Damage
Giant Enhancement Bonus vs. Racial Group +4

items.Name: Insignia of House Tormtor
items.Description: Most Drow wear a brooch that identifies which Noble House they are a member of, or are allied with. This one looks like an electrum javelin and is the insignia of House Tormtor.

items.Name: Vegetables
items.Description: In culinary terms, a vegetable is an edible plant or its part, intended for cooking or eating raw.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Minor Wounds (1) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Wand of Cold
items.Description: Wands of Cold draw upon a discipline of magic that has been studied and venerated for centuries, one whose practitioners are so varied that there can be no determining where the concept originated.

items.Name: Wand of Viscid Gobs
items.Description: This Wand can shoot forth blobs of a sticky glue-like material which will surround a victim and can render them immobile.
PropertiesDecoded: Dragon Breath, Paralysis Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: War Monk Outfit +1
items.Description: The Shining Hand Monastery in Vaasa has made an impressive reputation, and a small fortune, designing these robes. Demand has spread across many nations, such that different variations on the similar robes keep the monks hard at work. The robes increase a monk’s senses to such a…

items.Name: White Dragon Cloak
items.Description: This cloak, made from the hide of a White Dragon, provides outstanding protection against cold-based attacks.

items.Name: Javelin of Lightning
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.
